Theorem
[convergence on surfaces of positive Euler characteristic] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 5.1.11\group Normalized Ricci Flow on Surfaces

On a compact surface with $\chi (M)>0$, for any initial metric, the solution of the normalized Ricci flow $(5.1.1)$ exists for all time, and converges in the $C^\infty $ topology to a metric with positive constant curvature.
